More details have emerged about the final days of Breaking Bad star RJ Mitte.

In an interview with TMZ, actor Luis Moncada, who played Marco Salamanca, tearfully recalled their last meeting, days before Mitte’s death. They went to the Albuquerque Balloon Fiesta, where Moncada took Mitte on his first hot-air balloon ride. They talked about personal struggles, and Moncada offered support: “Let’s stick together, brother. Rest your head on my shoulder. Things will get better.”

Moncada said Mitte was under enormous pressure but declined his offer to stay with him after they spent nearly an hour together outside the airport. Mitte said he’d traveled too long and wanted to go home. Moncada asked him to call if he ever needed someone, but the call never came.

“What hurts most” is that Mitte had supported Moncada through a difficult time, but Moncada couldn’t be there for him.
